description: Source code for Kubernetes resource quota access and management, including quota retrieval, caching, and status updates.

classes.name: quotaAccessor
classes.description: Implements QuotaAccessor interface; manages quota cache, live lookups, and status updates.

methods.name: newQuotaAccessor
methods.description: Creates a new quotaAccessor instance with caches initialized.

methods.name: UpdateQuotaStatus
methods.description: Persists the updated quota status to Kubernetes API.

methods.name: checkCache
methods.description: Compares quota resource versions and returns the most recent, removing stale cache entries.

methods.name: GetQuotas
methods.description: Retrieves quotas for a namespace, using cache, live lookup, and API calls as needed.
